Get means and SD of technical and then bioogical replictes
```{r}
# Get means + SD of technical replicates
cyt <- read.table("../CriptoFc/data/other/IQUE_190930_figure2A.csv", header = TRUE, sep=";")
cyt$Value <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", gsub("\\.", "", cyt$Value))) # Convert Value to numeric

# Calculate mean and sd of technical replicates
cyt_stats <- cyt %>%
  group_by(Sample, Biological) %>%
  summarize(
    mean = mean(Value),
    sd = sd(Value),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Get means + SD of biological replicates (from means of technical replicates)
cyt_stats_stats <- cyt_stats %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarize(
    CriptoFc_cytometry = mean(mean),
    sd_means = sd(mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


# Exprot data & add short_name column to use in barplots_Cripto.Rmd figure 2B
```{r}
cyt_df <- cyt_stats_stats

cyt_df <- cyt_df %>%
  mutate(short_name = case_when(
    Sample == "Expi" ~ "Expi293_neg",
    Sample == "Expi_CriptoFc" ~ "Expi293_CriptoFC",
    Sample == "Expi_CriptoFc_ULK1" ~ "Expi293_CriptoFC_ULK1",
    Sample == "Expi_CriptoFc_inhib" ~ "Expi293_CriptoFC_Inhib",
    Sample == "Expi_ULK1_KO" ~ "Vulko293_neg",
    Sample == "Expi_ULK1_KO_CriptoFc" ~ "Vulko293_CriptoFC",
    Sample == "Expi_ULK1_KO_CriptoFc_ULK1" ~ "Vulko293_CriptoFC_ULK1",
    Sample == "Expi_ULK1_KO_CriptoFc_inhib" ~ "Vulko293_CriptoFC_Inhib",
    TRUE ~ NA
  ))

write.csv(cyt_df, "../CriptoFc/data/other/mean_CriptoFc_cytometry.csv")
```


Function to calculate pval and LFC between groups (biological replicates, not technical)
```{r}
# Calculate pval and LFC
get_LFC_pval <- function(data, group1, group2){
  data_1 <- data[data$Sample == group1,]
  data_2 <- data[data$Sample == group2,]
  
  LFC <- mean(data_2$mean)/mean(data_1$mean)
  LFC <- signif(LFC,2)
  
  t_test <- t.test(data_1$mean, data_2$mean)
  pval <- t_test$p.value
  pval <- signif(pval, 2)
  
  return(list(LFC,pval))
}

```



Figure 2A 
Colors from https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/khroma/vignettes/tol.html#sunset
```{r}
# Get labels for LFC and pvalues for expi vs KO comparison
exp_vs_KO <- get_LFC_pval(cyt_stats, "Expi_CriptoFc", "Expi_ULK1_KO_CriptoFc")
exp_vs_KO_label <- glue('{exp_vs_KO[[1]]}x (pval:{exp_vs_KO[[2]]})')

# Get labels for LFC and pvalues for expi vs KO+inhib comparison
exp_vs_KO_inhib <- get_LFC_pval(cyt_stats, "Expi_CriptoFc", "Expi_ULK1_KO_CriptoFc_inhib")
exp_vs_KO_inhib_label <- glue('{exp_vs_KO_inhib[[1]]}x (pval:{exp_vs_KO_inhib[[2]]})')


fig2A <- ggplot(cyt_stats_stats, aes(x = factor(Sample),
                      y = CriptoFc_cytometry,
                      fill = factor(Sample),
                      colour = factor(Sample))) + 
  geom_bar(aes(group = factor(Sample)), stat = "identity", width = 0.7, position = position_dodge(0.9),
           alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CriptoFc_cytometry - sd_means, ymax = CriptoFc_cytometry + sd_means, group = factor(Sample)),
                position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#364B9A", "#4A7BB7", "#6EA6CD","#98CAE1","#A50026", "#DD3D2D", "#F67E4B","#FDB366")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#364B9A", "#4A7BB7", "#6EA6CD","#98CAE1","#A50026", "#DD3D2D", "#F67E4B","#FDB366")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x="", y="Cripto-Fc expression", title = "Cripto-Fc expression flow cytometry") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2, y = 420000, xend = 6, yend = 420000)) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 4, y = 450000, label = exp_vs_KO_label, hjust = "center") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2, y = 600000, xend = 7, yend = 600000)) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 4, y = 630000, label = exp_vs_KO_inhib_label, hjust = "center") +
    theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15)
    )

pdf("../CriptoFc/results/barplots/figure2A.pdf", width = 6, height = 6)  # 6x6 inches
print(fig2A)
dev.off()


```
